project: Bitcoin Price Prediction using LSTM Neural Networks
supplied_notebook_validation_notes: The scaler was fitted on the complete feature matrix before splitting.
The final 20 percent holdout was used both as validation_data and final reported test data.
The supplied metrics are therefore not a strict untouched-test estimate.
